claim_boundary: external frozen matched-target coordinate tracking for factorial condition A; no internal adaptation, routing, learning, or causal channel claim
fitting_rule: Fit cue6 decoder, normalization and trackers only on base-order train32. Apply unchanged objects to paired base-order eval32 and heldout-order eval32.
decision_rule: Compare this condition with factorial B within parameter seed. A strict heldout pass requires orthogonal true-label R2 greater than latest-cue and conditional-shuffle R2. No condition effect is claimed without the same seed-level direction in at least three of four seeds.
